name: Yaounde
description: Cameroon's verdant capital in the hills. Explore political landmarks, art galleries, bustling markets, and lush parks.

name: Reunification Monument
description: Iconic twin-spired monument celebrating the reunification of Cameroon. A must-see landmark at Constitution Square.

name: National Museum
description: Housed in the former presidential palace, this museum showcases Cameroon's cultural heritage, traditional crafts, and historical artifacts.
image_asset: i love my country cameroon monument.webp

name: Mount Febe
description: A peaceful hilltop retreat just outside Yaounde with botanical gardens, hiking trails, and panoramic views of the capital.

name: Biyeme Market
description: One of Yaounde's liveliest markets. Shop for fresh produce, textiles, handmade crafts, and street food flavors.

name: Yaounde Grand Mosque
description: A beautiful example of Islamic architecture in the heart of the capital. Admire the minarets and serene courtyard.

name: Mvog-Betsi Zoo
description: A small but charming zoo near Yaounde featuring local wildlife including primates, birds, and reptiles. Great for families.

name: Bastos District
description: Upscale neighborhood with embassies, cafes, and restaurants. Experience modern Yaounde life, nightlife, and fine dining.

name: Memorial Museum
description: Dedicated to Cameroon's independence heroes and political history. A solemn and educational stop for history buffs.
image_asset: i love my country cameroon monument.webp

name: Cite Verte Park
description: A lush green park in the heart of Yaounde. Ideal for morning walks, picnics, and escaping the city buzz.
